shortAnswer: For Middle East and UAE buyers comparing custom paper tube packaging suppliers, the useful starting point is not a generic supplier list. A practical RFQ should compare product fit, tube structure, cap style, artwork status, finish direction, quantity range, destination market and document requests that need project review. MUGE PACKAGING provides an official paper tube packaging source page for buyers preparing this comparison.
